intro.heading: Roofing Built for The Woodlands
intro.body_p1: The Woodlands presents a distinct set of roofing challenges. Dense tree canopy accelerates moisture and debris accumulation on shingles. Seasonal hailstorms — common across Montgomery County — can compromise roofs that appear undamaged from the ground. And the intense heat and humidity of the Houston area puts ongoing stress on every component of a residential roofing system.
intro.body_p2: Home Team works with homeowners throughout The Woodlands to assess their current roof, identify what needs attention, and deliver honest recommendations — whether that is a targeted repair or a full replacement built to handle whatever Texas weather brings next.
intro.callout_text: Home Team serves homeowners throughout The Woodlands and neighboring communities including Spring, Tomball, Conroe, and Cypress. Free inspections available — no pressure, no obligation.

items.q: How do I know if I need a roof repair or a full replacement?
items.a: A repair is usually appropriate when damage is localized — a few missing shingles, isolated flashing issues, or a small leak with an identifiable source. Replacement becomes the better investment when a roof is aging (typically 15–20+ years for standard asphalt shingles in the Texas climate), when damage is widespread, or when repeated repairs are adding up. Home Team will assess your specific roof and give you an honest recommendation — not a sales pitch. The only way to know for certain is a proper inspection.

items.q: What should I do after a hailstorm in The Woodlands?
items.a: First, avoid getting on the roof yourself — storm damage is not always visible from the ground and wet surfaces are dangerous. Look for obvious signs like dented gutters, cracked or missing shingles, or granules in your downspouts. Then schedule a professional inspection as soon as possible. Storm damage can worsen quickly in the Texas heat and humidity, and timely documentation matters. Home Team offers free post-storm inspections in The Woodlands with no obligation to proceed.

items.q: How long does roof replacement typically take?
items.a: Most residential roof replacements in The Woodlands are completed in one to two days, depending on the size and complexity of the roof, the materials selected, and the weather. Home Team will give you a clear timeline before work begins. The crew protects your property throughout the project and completes a thorough cleanup before each day ends.

items.q: What roofing materials work best for Texas weather?
items.a: For The Woodlands climate — intense summer heat, high UV exposure, and active hail and storm seasons — Home Team recommends impact-resistant architectural shingles rated for high-wind and hail exposure, paired with quality synthetic underlayment and a properly designed attic ventilation system. Class 4 impact-rated shingles also qualify for insurance discounts under many Texas policies. Your inspector will walk you through the options that fit your home, any applicable HOA requirements, and your budget.
